items.name: bool_dist_wrt_gp
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_gp : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n)
  (gF gG : Corner n -> bool),
  (forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) ->
  l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq (embed gF) (embed gG)))
  <= l1_norm F * bool_dist_wrt G gG
   + bool_dist_wrt F gF * l1_norm (embed gG).

items.name: BoolFormula
items.statement:
Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type :=
  | BVar   : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n                          
  | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n                             
  | BAnd   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BOr    : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BNot   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: eval_bf
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_bf {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i     => match Vector.nth c i with Pos => true | Neg => false end
  | BConst b   => b
  | BAnd p q   => andb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BOr p q    => orb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BNot p     => negb (eval_bf p c)
  end.

items.name: translate
items.statement:
Fixpoint translate {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : GA_expr n :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i       => Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i))
  | BConst true  => Scalar 1
  | BConst false => Scalar 0
  | BAnd p q     => Conv (translate p) (translate q)             
  | BNot p       => Add (Scalar 1) (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (translate p))
  | BOr p q      => Add (Add (translate p) (translate q))
                         (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (Conv (translate p) (translate q)))
  end.

items.name: max_l1_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_l1_during {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1
  | Scalar c  => Qabs c
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      max_l1_during sq e1 + max_l1_during sq e2
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  end.

items.statement:
Lemma l1_eval_le_max_l1_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),

items.name: max_booldist_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_booldist_during {n}
  (sq : Vector.t Q n)
  (f  : Corner n -> bool)
  (e  : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _  => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Scalar _ => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) f)
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  end.

items.name: booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during

Lemma booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) (e : GA_expr n),
    dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f <= max_booldist_during sq f e.

items.name: trace_boolish_le
items.statement:
Fixpoint trace_boolish_le {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ | Scalar _ => boolish_le (eval_expr sq e) d
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) d
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  end.

items.name: ExcNum
exc_of
exc_le
items.statement:
Definition exc_le (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a < exc_grade b)%nat \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a < exc_l1 b) \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a == exc_l1 b).

items.name: exc_pre
items.statement:
Definition exc_pre (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a <= exc_grade b)%nat /\ exc_l1 a <= exc_l1 b.

items.name: computes
items.statement:
Definition computes {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall m : Mask n, eval_expr sq e m == embed f m.

items.name: expr_size
items.statement:
Fixpoint expr_size {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ => 1
  | Scalar _ => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Mul e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Conv e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  end.

items.name: easy_under
items.statement:
Definition easy_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q)
  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f /\
    exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\
    trace_boolish_le sq e d.

items.name: hard_under
items.statement:
Definition hard_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q)
  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f ->
    ~ (exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\ trace_boolish_le sq e d).

  | Cln_Grade.Mul e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2

items.name: l1_norm_scale_one

Lemma l1_norm_scale_one : forall (c : Q),
  l1_norm (mv_scale c (@mv_one n)) == Qabs c.

items.name: Qmult_le_compat_nonneg
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_le_compat_nonneg : forall a b c d : Q,
  0 <= a -> 0 <= c -> a <= b -> c <= d -> a * c <= b * d.

items.name: l1_norm_eval_le
items.statement:
Theorem l1_norm_eval_le :
  forall (e : GA_expr n),
    l1_norm (eval_expr sq e) <= l1_bound e.

items.name: Sign
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: sign_eqb
items.statement:
Definition sign_eqb (a b : Sign) : bool :=
  match a, b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _, _ => false
  end.

items.name: sign_eqb_refl
items.statement: Lemma sign_eqb_refl : forall s, sign_eqb s s = true.

items.name: sign_eqb_eq
items.statement: Lemma sign_eqb_eq : forall a b, sign_eqb a b = true -> a = b.

items.name: sign_eq_dec
items.statement: Lemma sign_eq_dec : forall (a b : Sign), {a = b} + {a <> b}.

items.name: Corner
items.statement: Definition Corner (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t Sign n.

items.name: Mask
items.statement: Definition Mask (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t bool n.

items.name: corner0
items.statement: Definition corner0 : Corner 0 := Vector.nil Sign.

items.name: corner_eq_dec
items.statement: Fixpoint corner_eq_dec {n : nat} (x y : Corner n) : {x = y} + {x <> y}.

items.name: grade
items.statement:
Definition grade {n} (m : Mask n) : nat :=
  List.count_occ Bool.bool_dec (Vector.to_list m) true.

items.name: grade_cons_true
items.statement:
Lemma grade_cons_true : forall n (m : Mask n),
  grade (Vector.cons _ true _ m) = S (grade m).

items.name: grade_cons_false
items.statement:
Lemma grade_cons_false : forall n (m : Mask n),
  grade (Vector.cons _ false _ m) = grade m.

items.name: grade_empty_mask
items.statement:
Lemma grade_empty_mask : forall n,
  grade (mask_empty (n:=n)) = 0%nat.

items.name: length_filter_le
items.statement:
Lemma length_filter_le :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    (length (filter p l) <= length l)%nat.

items.name: NoDup_filter
items.statement:
Lemma NoDup_filter :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    NoDup l -> NoDup (filter p l).

items.name: NoDup_incl_length
items.statement:
Lemma NoDup_incl_length :
  forall (A : Type) (l1 l2 : list A),
    NoDup l1 -> incl l1 l2 -> (length l1 <= length l2)%nat.

items.name: filter_ext_in
items.statement:
Lemma filter_ext_in :
  forall (A : Type) (l : list A) (p q : A -> bool),
    (forall x, In x l -> p x = q x) ->
    filter p l = filter q l.

items.name: all_masks_length_pow2
items.statement:
Lemma all_masks_length_pow2 :
  forall n, length (all_masks n) = Nat.pow 2 n.

items.name: Qeq_bool_10
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_10 : Qeq_bool 1 0 = false.

items.name: Qeq_bool_00
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_00 : Qeq_bool 0 0 = true.

items.name: support_size
items.statement:
Definition support_size {n} (F : MV n) : nat :=
  length (List.filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0))
                 (all_masks n)).

items.name: support_size_ext
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_ext :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (forall m, F m == G m) ->
    support_size F = support_size G.

items.name: support_list
items.statement:
Definition support_list {n} (F : MV n) : list (Mask n) :=
  filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n).

items.name: support_size_le_2n
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_le_2n : forall n (F : MV n),
  (support_size F <= Nat.pow 2 n)%nat.

items.name: support_size_zero
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_zero : forall n,
  support_size (@mv_zero n) = 0%nat.

items.name: filter_all_false_nil
items.statement:
Lemma filter_all_false_nil :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    (forall x, In x l -> p x = false) ->
    filter p l = [].

items.name: filter_singleton
items.statement:
Lemma filter_singleton :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A) (a : A),
    NoDup l ->
    In a l ->
    p a = true ->
    (forall x, In x l -> x <> a -> p x = false) ->
    filter p l = [a].

items.name: support_size_basis
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_basis : forall n (i : Fin.t n),
  support_size (basis (mask_single i)) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_mv_one
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_mv_one : forall n,
  support_size (@mv_one n) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_scale
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scale : forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n),
  ~(c == 0) ->
  support_size (mv_scale c F) = support_size F.

items.name: support_size_add
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_add : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (support_size (mv_add F G) <= support_size F + support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_conv
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_conv : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (support_size (mv_conv F G) <= support_size F * support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound
items.statement:
Fixpoint support_size_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _    => 1
  | Scalar _   => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2  => support_size_bound e1 + support_size_bound e2
  | Mul e1 e2  =>
      match e1, e2 with
      | Scalar _, _ => support_size_bound e2
      | _, Scalar _ => support_size_bound e1
      | _, _        => Nat.pow 2 n
      end
  | Conv e1 e2 => support_size_bound e1 * support_size_bound e2
  end.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_l
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mul_scalar_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    forall m,
      eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e) m
      ==
      mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_r
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mul_scalar_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    forall m,
      eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q)) m
      ==
      mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_l
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e))
     <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q)))
     <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: eval_support_size_le
items.statement:
Theorem eval_support_size_le :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq e) <= support_size_bound e)%nat.

items.name: formula_size
items.statement:
Fixpoint formula_size {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat :=
  match phi with
  | BVar _   => 1
  | BConst _ => 1
  | BAnd p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q
  | BOr p q  => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q
  | BNot p   => 1 + formula_size p
  end.

items.name: formula_size_pos
items.statement:
Lemma formula_size_pos : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n),
  (formula_size phi >= 1)%nat.

items.name: pow2_pos
items.statement: Lemma pow2_pos : forall k, (1 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: pow2_ge_2
items.statement: Lemma pow2_ge_2 : forall k, (k >= 1)%nat -> (2 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound_translate
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_bound_translate :
  forall n (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (support_size_bound (translate phi) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: translate_support_size_bound
items.statement:
Corollary translate_support_size_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (translate phi))
     <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: neg1_pow
items.statement:
Definition neg1_pow (k : nat) : Q :=
  if Nat.even k then 1%Q else (-(1))%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_S
items.statement: Lemma neg1_pow_S : forall k, neg1_pow (S k) == (- neg1_pow k)%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_neq_0
items.statement: Lemma neg1_pow_neq_0 : forall k, ~(neg1_pow k == 0).

items.name: bQ_XOR_plus_chi
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_XOR_plus_chi : forall n (s : Corner n),
  (2 * bQ (XOR_n_func s) + neg1_pow n * chi' (Vector.const true n) s == 1)%Q.

items.name: XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Definition XOR_explicit {n} : MV n :=
  mv_add (mv_scale (1#2) (basis mask_empty))
         (mv_scale (- neg1_pow n * (1#2)) (basis (Vector.const true n))).

items.name: eval_XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma eval_XOR_explicit : forall n (s : Corner n),
  eval (@XOR_explicit n) s == bQ (XOR_n_func s).

items.name: embed_XOR_eq_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma embed_XOR_eq_explicit : forall n (m : Mask n),
  embed (@XOR_n_func n) m == (@XOR_explicit n) m.

items.name: mask_empty_neq_full
items.statement:
Lemma mask_empty_neq_full : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> @mask_empty n <> Vector.const true n.

items.name: XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n mask_empty == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_full_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_full_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_other_zero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_other_zero : forall n (m : Mask n),
  m <> mask_empty ->
  m <> Vector.const true n ->
  @XOR_explicit n m == 0.

items.name: support_size_at_least_two
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_at_least_two :
  forall n (F : MV n) (a b : Mask n),
    a <> b -> ~(F a == 0) -> ~(F b == 0) ->
    (2 <= support_size F)%nat.

items.name: support_size_basis_general
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_basis_general : forall n (M : Mask n),
  support_size (basis M) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR_explicit_le
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR_explicit_le :
  forall n, (support_size (@XOR_explicit n) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint IP_raw (l : list Sign) : bool :=
  match l with
  | nil         => false
  | _ :: nil    => false                                    
  | x :: y :: rest =>
      xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (IP_raw rest)
  end.

items.name: IP_n_func
items.statement:
Definition IP_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  IP_raw (Vector.to_list c).

items.name: IP_n_func_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma IP_n_func_cons2 :
  forall n (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    @IP_n_func (S (S n)) (Vector.cons _ x _ (Vector.cons _ y _ c))
    = xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (@IP_n_func n c).

items.name: signed
items.statement: Definition signed (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: signed_xorb
items.statement: Lemma signed_xorb : forall a b, signed (xorb a b) == (signed a * signed b)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun a => (signed (f a) * chi' M a)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: bQ_via_signed
items.statement: Lemma bQ_via_signed : forall b, bQ b == ((1 - signed b) * (1#2))%Q.

items.name: AND_2
items.statement:
Definition AND_2 (c : Corner 2) : bool :=
  andb (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd c))
       (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c))).

items.name: signed_walsh_2
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh_2 (f : Corner 2 -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) : Q :=
  signed_walsh f (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ (Vector.nil _))).

items.name: prod_pairs_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint prod_pairs_raw (l : list bool) : Q :=
  match l with
  | []            => 1%Q
  | [_]           => 1%Q                                    
  | b1 :: b2 :: rest =>
      (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs_raw rest)%Q
  end.

items.name: prod_pairs
items.statement:
Definition prod_pairs (m : nat) (M : Mask (m + m)) : Q :=
  prod_pairs_raw (Vector.to_list M).

items.name: Sn_plus_Sn
items.statement: Lemma Sn_plus_Sn : forall m, S (S ((m + m)%nat)) = (S m + S m)%nat.

items.name: mask_cast
items.statement:
Definition mask_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1) : Mask n2 :=
  eq_rect n1 (Vector.t bool) M n2 H.

items.name: to_list_cast
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1),
  Vector.to_list (mask_cast H M) = Vector.to_list M.

items.name: prod_pairs_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_cons2 : forall m (b1 b2 : bool) (M : Mask (m + m)),
  prod_pairs (S m) (mask_cast (Sn_plus_Sn m)
    (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ M)))
  = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M)%Q.

items.name: vector_peel2
items.statement:
Lemma vector_peel2 : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v : Vector.t A (S (S n))),
  exists (a1 a2 : A) (v' : Vector.t A n),
    Vector.to_list v = a1 :: a2 :: Vector.to_list v'.

items.name: Sm_plus_Sm
items.statement: Lemma Sm_plus_Sm : forall m, (S m + S m)%nat = (S (S (m + m)%nat)).

items.name: mask_decompose2
items.statement:
Lemma mask_decompose2 : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  exists b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M''.

items.name: prod_pairs_unfold
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_unfold : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  forall b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M'' ->
    prod_pairs (S m) M = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M'')%Q.

items.name: inject_Z
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> a * b == a * c.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> b * a == c * a.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> a - c == b - c.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> c - a == c - b.

items.name: embed_via_signed_walsh
items.statement:
Lemma embed_via_signed_walsh : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n),
  embed f M == ((1 / pow2 n) * ((1#2) * (if mask_eq_dec M mask_empty then pow2 n else 0)
                - (1#2) * signed_walsh f M))%Q.

items.name: all_corners_2
signed_walsh_AND_2var
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_AND_2var : forall (b1 b2 : bool),
  signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 ==
    if b1 then (if b2 then (-2)%Q else (-2)%Q)
    else (if b2 then (-2)%Q else 2%Q).

items.name: all_corners_S
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_S : forall n,
  all_corners (S n)
  =
    map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos n c) (all_corners n)
 ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg n c) (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_SS
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS : forall n,
  all_corners (S (S n))
  =
     map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n).

items.name: chi'_cons2_factor
items.statement:
Lemma chi'_cons2_factor :
  forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n) (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    chi' (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
         (Vector.cons _ x  _ (Vector.cons _ y  _ c))
    ==
    ((if b1 then sQ x else 1%Q) *
     (if b2 then sQ y else 1%Q) *
     chi' m c)%Q.

items.name: to_list_inj
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_inj : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v1 v2 : Vector.t A n),
  Vector.to_list v1 = Vector.to_list v2 -> v1 = v2.

items.name: corner_cast
items.statement:
Definition corner_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1) : Corner n2 :=
  eq_rect n1 Corner c n2 H.

items.name: to_list_corner_cast
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_corner_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1),
  Vector.to_list (corner_cast H c) = Vector.to_list c.

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq : forall k x y : Q,
  k * (x + y) == k * x + k * y.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_l
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_l :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => k * f x) l) == k * sumQ (map f l).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq : forall k x y : Q,
  (x + y) * k == x * k + y * k.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_r :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) l) == (sumQ (map f l) * k)%Q.

items.name: chi_eq_chi'
items.statement:
Lemma chi_eq_chi' : forall n (m:Mask n) (c:Corner n),
  chi m c == chi' m c.

items.name: sumQ_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_flat_map :
  forall (A B : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> Q),
    sumQ (map f (flat_map g l))
    ==
    sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map f (g a))) l).

items.name: map_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma map_flat_map :
  forall (A B C : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> C),
    map f (flat_map g l) = flat_map (fun a => map f (g a)) l.

items.name: cons2
items.statement:
Definition cons2 {n} (c2 : Corner 2) (x : Corner n) : Corner (S (S n)) :=
  Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd c2) (S n)
    (Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c2)) n x).

items.name: all_corners_SS_flatmap
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS_flatmap :
  forall n,
    all_corners (S (S n)) =
      flat_map
        (fun c2 : Corner 2 =>
           map (fun x : Corner n => cons2 c2 x) (all_corners n))
        (all_corners 2).

items.name: signed_walsh_tensor2
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_tensor2 :
  forall n (g : Corner 2 -> bool) (h : Corner n -> bool)
         (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n),
    signed_walsh
      (fun a : Corner (S (S n)) =>
         xorb (g (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd a) _
                  (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd (Vector.tl a)) _ (Vector.nil _))))
              (h (Vector.tl (Vector.tl a))))
      (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
    ==
    (signed_walsh_2 g b1 b2 * signed_walsh h m)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_factored
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_factored : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == prod_pairs m M.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_magnitude
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_magnitude : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  exists s : bool, signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M 
                    == signed s * inject_Z (Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat m)).

items.name: pow2_injectZ
items.statement:
Lemma pow2_injectZ : forall n,
  pow2 n == inject_Z (2 ^ Z.of_nat n).

items.name: Zpow2_nat_eq_1
items.statement:
Lemma Zpow2_nat_eq_1 : forall n,
  Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat n) = 1%Z -> n = 0%nat.

items.name: embed_IP_all_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma embed_IP_all_nonzero : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  ~ (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == 0).

items.name: support_size_IP
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_IP : forall m,
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m))) = Nat.pow 2 (m + m).

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound
items.statement:
Theorem IP_formula_size_lower_bound :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m)%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight
items.statement:
Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight :

items.statement: Variable rho : nat -> bool.

items.name: eval_gate_list
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_gate_list (fuel : nat) (gs : list Gate) (i : nat) : bool :=
    match fuel with
    | 0 => false
    | S fuel' =>
        match nth_error gs i with
        | None => false
        | Some g =>
            match g with
            | GConst b => b
            | GInput x => rho x
            | GNot a => negb (eval_gate_list fuel' gs a)
            | GAnd a b => andb (eval_gate_list fuel' gs a) (eval_gate_list fuel' gs b)
            | GXor a b => xorb (eval_gate_list fuel' gs a) (eval_gate_list fuel' gs b)
            | GOr  a b => orb  (eval_gate_list fuel' gs a) (eval_gate_list fuel' gs b)
            end
        end
    end.

Definition eval_gate (ρ:BEnv) (vals:list bool) (g:Gate) : bool :=
  match g with
  | GConst b => b
  | GInput x => ρ x
  | GNot i   => negb (nth i vals false)
  | GAnd i j => andb (nth i vals false) (nth j vals false)
  | GXor i j => xorb (nth i vals false) (nth j vals false)
  | GOr  i j => orb  (nth i vals false) (nth j vals false)
  end.

items.name: eval_gates_fwd

  match gs with
  | [] => acc
  | g::tl =>
      let v := eval_gate ρ acc g in
      eval_gates_fwd ρ tl (acc ++ [v])
  end.

Definition eval_circuit (C:Circuit) (ρ:BEnv) : bool :=
  let vals := eval_gates_fwd ρ C.(gates) [] in

items.statement: Definition bQ (b : bool) : Q := if b then 1%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: compile_gate
items.statement:
Definition compile_gate (g : Gate) : GAExpr n :=
    match g with
    | GConst b => EScale (bQ b) 0                                                              
    | GInput x => EVar x
    | GNot a   =>         EAdd      0 0
    | GAnd a b => EGp a b
    | GXor a b =>               EAdd      0 0
    | GOr  a b =>              EAdd      0 0
    end.

items.name: shift_gate
items.statement:
Fixpoint shift_gate (g : Gate) : Gate :=
    match g with
    | GConst b => GConst b
    | GInput x => GInput x
    | GNot a => GNot (2 + a)
    | GAnd a b => GAnd (2 + a) (2 + b)
    | GXor a b => GXor (2 + a) (2 + b)
    | GOr  a b => GOr  (2 + a) (2 + b)
    end.

items.name: compile_gate2
items.statement:
Definition compile_gate2 (g : Gate) : GAExpr n :=
    match g with
    | GConst b =>
        if b then EOne else EZero
    | GInput x =>
        EVar x
    | GNot a =>
                            
        EAdd 1 (                 0 )                                                
    | GAnd a b =>
        EGp a b
    | GXor a b =>
                     
        EAdd 0 0              
    | GOr a b =>
                    
        EAdd 0 0              
    end.

items.name: St
items.statement: Definition St := list (GAExpr n).

items.name: emit
items.statement:
Definition emit (e : GAExpr n) (st : St) : (nat * St) :=
    let idx := length st in
    (idx, st ++ [e]).

items.name: compile_gate_st
items.statement:
Definition compile_gate_st (g : Gate) (st : St) : (nat * St) :=
    match g with
    | GConst b =>
        if b then (1, st) else (0, st)                                  
    | GInput x =>
        emit (EVar x) st
    | GNot a =>
                                   
        let '(t, st1) := emit (EScale (-1)%Q a) st in
        emit (EAdd 1 t) st1
    | GAnd a b =>
        emit (EGp a b) st
    | GXor a b =>
                                                                 
        let '(ab, st1) := emit (EGp a b) st in
        let '(twoab, st2) := emit (EScale 2%Q ab) st1 in
        let '(s, st3) := emit (EAdd a b) st2 in
        let '(neg, st4) := emit (EScale (-1)%Q twoab) st3 in
        emit (EAdd s neg) st4
    | GOr a b =>
                                                                 
        let '(ab, st1) := emit (EGp a b) st in
        let '(s, st2) := emit (EAdd a b) st1 in
        let '(negab, st3) := emit (EScale (-1)%Q ab) st2 in
        emit (EAdd s negab) st3
    end.

items.name: compile_gates
items.statement:
Fixpoint compile_gates (gs : list Gate) (st : St) : (list nat * St) :=
    match gs with
    | [] => ([], st)
    | g :: tl =>
        let '(idx, st1) := compile_gate_st g st in
        let '(idxs, st2) := compile_gates tl st1 in
        (idx :: idxs, st2)
    end.

items.name: compile
items.statement:
Definition compile (C : Circuit) : GAProg n :=
    let gs2 := map shift_gate C.(gates) in
    let st0 : St := [EZero; EOne] in
    let '(idxs, stF) := compile_gates gs2 st0 in
    {| defs := stF;
       out  :=                                                         
                                                                         
                                                        
               match nth_error idxs C.(out) with
               | Some k => k
               | None => 0
               end |}.

items.statement:

      wf_circuit C ->
      eval_prog (n:=n) sq (env_of_rho rho) (compile C)
      =
      as_scalar (bQ (eval_circuit rho C)).

Fixpoint wf_defs {n} (k : nat) (ds : list (GAExpr n)) : Prop :=
  match ds with
  | [] => True
  | d :: tl =>
      (match d with
       | EZero => True
       | EOne => True
       | EVar _ => True
       | EAdd i j => i < k /\ j < k
       | EScale _ i => i < k
       | EGp i j => i < k /\ j < k
       end)
      /\ wf_defs (S k) tl
  end.

items.name: eval_idx
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_idx (fuel : nat) (ds : list (GAExpr n)) (i : nat) : MV n :=
    match fuel with
    | 0 => mv_zero
    | S fuel' =>
        match nth_error ds i with
        | None => mv_zero
        | Some e =>
            match e with
            | EZero => mv_zero
            | EOne => mv_one
            | EVar x => env x
            | EAdd a b =>
                mv_add (eval_idx fuel' ds a) (eval_idx fuel' ds b)
            | EScale k a =>
                mv_scale k (eval_idx fuel' ds a)
            | EGp a b =>
                mv_gp n sq (eval_idx fuel' ds a) (eval_idx fuel' ds b)
            end
        end
    end.

items.name: eval_prog
items.statement:
Definition eval_prog (p : GAProg n) : MV n :=
                                                                                 
    eval_idx (S (length p.(defs))) p.(defs) p.(out).

items.name: deps
items.statement:
Definition deps (e : GAExpr n) : list nat :=
    match e with
    | EZero => []
    | EOne => []
    | EVar _ => []
    | EAdd i j => [i; j]
    | EScale _ i => [i]
    | EGp i j => [i; j]
    end.

items.name: depth_step
items.statement:
Definition depth_step (tab : list nat) (e : GAExpr n) : nat :=
    match deps e with
    | [] => 1
    | ds =>
        1 + fold_right Nat.max 0 (map (fun i => nth i tab 0) ds)
    end.

items.name: depth_table
items.statement:
Fixpoint depth_table (ds : list (GAExpr n)) : list nat :=
    match ds with
    | [] => []
    | e :: tl =>
        let tab := depth_table tl in
                                                                                
                                                             
        (depth_step tab e) :: tab
    end.

items.name: grade

items.name: rank_empty

items.name: rank_monotone

items.name: rank_subspace_bound

items.name: rank_independence
items.statement:

  rank vs = length vs <->
                                      
  forall (coeffs : list Q),
    length coeffs = length vs ->
    (sumQ (map (fun '(c, v) => mv_scale c v) 
               (combine coeffs vs))) = mv_zero ->
    forall c, List.In c coeffs -> c == 0.

  let all_supports := 
    flat_map (fun v => 
      filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (v m) 0)) (all_masks n)
    ) vs
  in
  length (nodup mask_eq_dec all_supports).

    InP f ->

items.name: Instr
items.statement:
Inductive Instr : Type :=
  | IPush  (c : A)
  | IAdd
  | IConv
  | IGp
  | IGauge (g : Gauge)
  | IDup
  | ISwap
  | IPop
  .

items.name: sstep
items.statement:
Inductive sstep : Stack -> Stack -> Prop :=
  | step_push : forall st c,
      sstep st (c :: st)

  | step_add : forall st x y,
      sstep (x :: y :: st) ((x + y)%tg :: st)

  | step_conv : forall st x y,
      sstep (x :: y :: st) ((x ⊙ y)%tg :: st)

  | step_gp : forall st x y,
      sstep (x :: y :: st) ((x ⋆ y)%tg :: st)

  | step_gauge : forall st g x,
      sstep (x :: st) (gauge g x :: st)

  | step_dup : forall st x,
      sstep (x :: st) (x :: x :: st)

  | step_swap : forall st x y,
      sstep (x :: y :: st) (y :: x :: st)

  | step_pop : forall st x,
      sstep (x :: st) st
  .

items.name: exec1
items.statement:
Definition exec1 (i : Instr) (st : Stack) : option Stack :=
    match i, st with
    | IPush c, st => Some (c :: st)
    | IAdd, x :: y :: st => Some ((x + y)%tg :: st)
    | IConv, x :: y :: st => Some ((x ⊙ y)%tg :: st)
    | IGp, x :: y :: st => Some ((x ⋆ y)%tg :: st)
    | IGauge g, x :: st => Some (gauge g x :: st)
    | IDup, x :: st => Some (x :: x :: st)
    | ISwap, x :: y :: st => Some (y :: x :: st)
    | IPop, _ :: st => Some st
    | _, _ => None
    end.

items.name: run_from
items.statement:
Fixpoint run_from (st : Stack) (p : Prog) : option (list Stack) :=
    match p with
    | [] => Some [st]
    | i :: tl =>
        match exec1 i st, run_from (match exec1 i st with Some st' => st' | None => st end) tl with
        | Some st', Some tr => Some (st :: tr)
        | _, _ => None
        end
    end.

items.name: runs
items.statement:
Inductive runs : Stack -> Prog -> list Stack -> Prop :=
  | runs_nil : forall st, runs st [] [st]
  | runs_cons :
      forall st i st' tl tr,
        sstep st st' ->
        runs st' tl tr ->
        runs st (i :: tl) (st :: tr).

             match p with
             | [] => st
             | i :: tl =>
                 match exec1 i st with
                 | Some st' => last_stack st' tl
                 | None => st
                 end
             end) st0 p with
    | stf => obs stf
    end.

      nat        -> Stack -> Prog ->
      nat               -> nat         ->
      list Stack -> Prop :=
  | runs_eff_nil : forall M st,
      runs_eff b M st [] 0%nat M [st]

  | runs_eff_cons_other :
      forall M st i st' tl t M' tr,
        i <> SM.IGp ->
        istep i st st' ->
        runs_eff b M st' tl t M' tr ->
        runs_eff b M st (i :: tl) t M' (st :: tr)

  | runs_eff_cons_gp_ineff :
      forall M st st' tl t M' tr,
        istep SM.IGp st st' ->
        runs_eff b M st' tl t M' tr ->
        runs_eff b M st (SM.IGp :: tl) t M' (st :: tr)

  | runs_eff_cons_gp_eff :
      forall M st st' x y tail tl t M' tr,
        st = x :: y :: tail ->
        st' = (x ⋆ y)%tg :: tail ->
                                                          
        (exists SX : Split x,
           (length (split_parts SX) >= M)%nat) ->
        (exists SY : Split y,
           (length (split_parts SY) >= b)%nat) ->
        runs_eff b (M * b) st' tl t M' tr ->
        runs_eff b M st (SM.IGp :: tl) (S t) M' (st :: tr).

Lemma last_nonempty_default_irrel :
      forall (A : Type) (l : list A) (d1 d2 : A),
        l <> [] -> List.last l d1 = List.last l d2.

items.name: last_of_nonempty
items.statement:
Lemma last_of_nonempty :
    forall (A : Type) (x : A) (xs : list A) (d : A),
      List.last (x :: xs) d = List.last (x :: xs) x.

items.name: last_match_form
items.statement:
Lemma last_match_form :
    forall (A : Type) (tr : list A) (d : A),
      List.last tr d =
      match tr with
      | [] => d
      | _ :: _ => List.last tr d
      end.

items.name: runs_eff_trace_nonempty
items.statement:
Lemma runs_eff_trace_nonempty :
    forall b M st p t M' tr,
      runs_eff b M st p t M' tr ->
      tr <> [].

items.name: runs_eff_obs_explosion
items.statement:
Theorem runs_eff_obs_explosion :
    forall b M st p t M' tr,
      runs_eff b M st p t M' tr ->
      HasSplitAtLeast (SM.obs st) M ->
      HasSplitAtLeast (SM.obs (List.last tr st)) (M * pow b t).

items.name: runs_eff_t_le_cost
items.statement:
Lemma runs_eff_t_le_cost :
    forall b M st p t M' tr,
      runs_eff b M st p t M' tr ->
      (t <= length p)%nat.

items.name: b
items.statement: Definition b : nat := 2%nat.

items.name: M0
items.statement: Definition M0 : nat := 1%nat.

items.name: runs_eff_sound_for_output
items.statement:
Axiom runs_eff_sound_for_output :
    forall (n : nat) (p : SM.Prog),
      exists (t : nat) (M' : nat) (tr : list SM.Stack),
        S5.runs_eff b M0 (Tgt.st0 n) p t M' tr /\
        SM.obs (List.last tr (Tgt.st0 n)) = SM.output (Tgt.st0 n) p.

items.name: start_has_split_1
items.statement:
Axiom start_has_split_1 :
    forall n, S5.HasSplitAtLeast (SM.obs (Tgt.st0 n)) M0.

items.name: target_forces_effective_count
items.statement:
Axiom target_forces_effective_count :
    forall (n : nat) (p : SM.Prog) (t : nat) (M' : nat) (tr : list SM.Stack),
      Tgt.Correct n p ->
      S5.runs_eff b M0 (Tgt.st0 n) p t M' tr ->
      (n <= t)%nat.

items.name: cost_lower_bound_from_effective_count
items.statement:
Theorem cost_lower_bound_from_effective_count :
    forall (n : nat) (p : SM.Prog),
      Tgt.Correct n p ->
      (SM.cost p >= n)%nat.

items.statement: Definition K := Z.

items.name: Sem
items.statement: Definition Sem := Z.

items.name: zero
items.statement: Definition zero : A := 0%Z.

items.name: add
items.statement: Definition add : A -> A -> A := Z.add.

items.name: neg
items.statement: Definition neg : A -> A := Z.opp.

items.name: smul
items.statement: Definition smul : K -> A -> A := Z.mul.

items.name: conv
items.statement: Definition conv : A -> A -> A := Z.mul.

items.name: gp
items.statement: Definition gp : A -> A -> A := Z.mul.

items.name: sem_zero
items.statement: Definition sem_zero : Sem := 0%Z.

items.name: sem_add
items.statement: Definition sem_add : Sem -> Sem -> Sem := Z.add.

items.name: sem_mul
items.statement: Definition sem_mul : Sem -> Sem -> Sem := Z.mul.

items.name: eval
items.statement: Definition eval : A -> Sem := fun x => x.

items.name: Semantic
items.statement: Definition Semantic (_ : A) : Prop := True.

items.name: Exc
items.statement: Definition Exc (_ : A) : nat := 0%nat.

items.name: step
items.statement: Definition step (x y : A) : Prop := (x <= y)%Z.

items.name: add_assoc
items.statement: Lemma add_assoc : forall x y z : A, x + (y + z) = (x + y) + z.

items.name: add_comm
items.statement: Lemma add_comm : forall x y : A, x + y = y + x.

items.name: add_zero_l
items.statement: Lemma add_zero_l : forall x : A, zero + x = x.

items.name: add_left_inv
items.statement: Lemma add_left_inv : forall x : A, (-x) + x = zero.

items.name: smul_distr_add
items.statement:
Lemma smul_distr_add :
    forall (c : K) (x y : A), c • (x + y) = (c • x) + (c • y).

items.name: conv_assoc
items.statement: Lemma conv_assoc : forall x y z : A, x ⊙ (y ⊙ z) = (x ⊙ y) ⊙ z.

items.name: conv_comm
items.statement: Lemma conv_comm : forall x y : A, x ⊙ y = y ⊙ x.

items.name: conv_add_l
items.statement: Lemma conv_add_l : forall x y z : A, (x + y) ⊙ z = (x ⊙ z) + (y ⊙ z).

items.name: conv_add_r
items.statement: Lemma conv_add_r : forall x y z : A, x ⊙ (y + z) = (x ⊙ y) + (x ⊙ z).

items.name: gp_assoc
items.statement: Lemma gp_assoc : forall x y z : A, x ⋆ (y ⋆ z) = (x ⋆ y) ⋆ z.

items.name: gp_add_l
items.statement: Lemma gp_add_l : forall x y z : A, (x + y) ⋆ z = (x ⋆ z) + (y ⋆ z).

items.name: gp_add_r
items.statement: Lemma gp_add_r : forall x y z : A, x ⋆ (y + z) = (x ⋆ y) + (x ⋆ z).

items.name: eval_zero_ax
items.statement: Lemma eval_zero_ax : eval zero = sem_zero.

items.name: eval_add_ax
items.statement: Lemma eval_add_ax : forall x y : A, eval (x + y) = sem_add (eval x) (eval y).

items.name: eval_conv_ax
items.statement: Lemma eval_conv_ax : forall x y : A, eval (x ⊙ y) = sem_mul (eval x) (eval y).

items.name: Exc_semantic_zero
items.statement: Lemma Exc_semantic_zero : forall x : A, Semantic x -> Exc x = 0%nat.

items.name: Exc_step_mono
items.statement:
Lemma Exc_step_mono :
    forall x y : A, step x y -> (Exc x <= Exc y)%nat.

items.name: Exc_add_le
items.statement:
Lemma Exc_add_le :
    forall x y : A,
      (Exc ((x + y)%tg) <= Nat.max (Exc x) (Exc y))%nat.

items.name: Exc_conv_le
items.statement:
Lemma Exc_conv_le :
    forall x y : A,
      (Exc ((x ⊙ y)%tg) <= Nat.max (Exc x) (Exc y))%nat.

items.name: Exc_gp_le
items.statement:
Lemma Exc_gp_le :
    forall x y : A,
      (Exc ((x ⋆ y)%tg) <= (Exc x + Exc y))%nat.

items.name: Gauge
items.statement: Definition Gauge : Type := unit.

items.name: gauge
items.statement: Definition gauge (_ : Gauge) (x : A) : A := x.

items.name: Exc_gauge_invariant
items.statement:
Lemma Exc_gauge_invariant :
    forall (g : Gauge) (x : A), Exc (gauge g x) = Exc x.
